SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_week, MIN(calendar_date) d0, MAX(calendar_date) d1, COUNT(*) n
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_period=2 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,3

SELECT d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) n_keys, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) n_ids, MIN(f.sale_date) mn, MAX(f.sale_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
GROUP BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN n.store_id=900 THEN n.net_sales END) web, COUNT(*) n
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT r.sales_line_id) ds, COUNT(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) dr, SUM(r.refund_net) refund
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), mine AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) ns
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY ALL),
ctl AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) cs
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND r.store_id<900 GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT COALESCE(m.fiscal_year,c.fiscal_year) fy, COALESCE(m.fiscal_week,c.fiscal_week) wk,
  SUM(m.ns) mine, SUM(c.cs) ctl, SUM(COALESCE(m.ns,0)-COALESCE(c.cs,0)) diff,
  SUM(CASE WHEN abs(COALESCE(m.ns,0)-COALESCE(c.cs,0))>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) stores_off
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON m.fiscal_year=c.fiscal_year AND m.fiscal_week=c.fiscal_week AND m.store_id=c.store_id
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.calendar_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date=d.calendar_date) lines
FROM dim_date d WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND (NOT d.is_trading_day OR d.is_public_holiday)
ORDER BY 3

SELECT s.store_id=900 AS is_web_store, o.status, o.web_order_id IS NULL AS no_order,
  COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) orders, SUM(f.net_amount) net, MIN(f.sale_date) mn, MAX(f.sale_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-01' AND DATE '2026-07-31' AND (s.store_id=900 OR o.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT 'store999_or_ZZ' k, d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) n, SUM(f.net_amount) net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND (s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test') GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'unjoined_store_or_product', d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*), SUM(f.net_amount)
FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND (s.store_key IS NULL OR p.product_key IS NULL) GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stores_trading', d.fiscal_year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id), NULL
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.fiscal_year AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week,
       ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS this_year_net_sales,
       ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS last_year_net_sales,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty
JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
